name: Routey - 自动爬取 + AI 解析 + 入库

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "deepseek-chat",
  "temperature": 0.2,
  "max_tokens": 4096,
  "response_format": {"type": "json_object"},
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "system",
      "content": "You are a professional travel itinerary engine. Return STRICT VALID JSON only.
Required JSON structure:
{
  "route_title": "行程标题",
  "city": "城市名",
  "country": "国家",
  "route_theme": "citywalk|food|beach|luxury|nature|shopping|culture",
  "mood": "氛围描述",
  "summary": "50字以内的路线概述",
  "days_count": 5,
  "budget_level": "low|medium|high",
  "travel_type": "solo|couple|family|friends",
  "pace": "relaxed|normal|fast",
  "best_time": "spring|summer|autumn|winter|all",
  "tags": "标签1,标签2,标签3",
  "cover_image_query": "English search term for cover photo",
  "days": [
    {
      "day": 1,
      "title": "Day 1 标题",
      "summary": "当日概述",
      "places": [
        {
          "time": "09:00",
          "name": "地点名称",
          "description": "活动描述",
          "intro": "50字以内的详细介绍",
          "category": "景点|美食|购物|住宿|休闲",
          "rating": 4.5,
          "price": "¥800",
          "duration_min": 90,
          "tags": "必去,打卡",
          "lat": 35.6762,
          "lng": 139.6503,
          "address": "Shinjuku, Tokyo, Japan",
          "image_query": "Shinjuku Gyoen garden"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

Rules:
1. Each day must have 5-8 places covering: 景点, 美食, 购物, 住宿, 休闲
2. lat/lng must be REAL WGS84 coordinates, accurate to 4 decimal places
3. price in local currency
4. rating range 3.0-5.0
5. category MUST be one of: 景点|美食|购物|住宿|休闲
6. Places in same day should be geographically close
7. Time from 09:00 to 21:00, logically ordered
8. Total places across all days >= 12
9. Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown"
    },
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "请为 {{ $json.city }}({{ $json.country }}) 生成一条 5 天精品旅行路线。
要求：
- 每天 5-8 个地点
- 覆盖景点、美食、购物、住宿、休闲
- 包含真实 GPS 坐标
- 关键词：{{ $json.keyword }}"
    }
  ]
}
